latest_release.name: Release v1.0.57
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed

Version bumped from 1.0.56 to 1.0.57

### Recent Changes
- Name a row-level pick only when one leaf is all the row's text; the landing can only withhold (SKY-20123) (#9312) (1539b947d)
- Keep the workflow live view streaming after a VNC close (SKY-20132) (#9311) (702731a9d)
- Skip the admission sleep in the provider-download cleanup-join test (SKY-20136) (#9310) (b895a9aa7)
- Name cloud-only test and doc locations without their paths in synced test comments (SKY-20137) (#9309) (de78273cb)
- Use neutral example domains in three synced comments and a docstring (SKY-20138) (#9308) (8830b79fd)
- Skip the application declaration on extraction blocks (SKY-20124) (#9307) (ef32f9caa)
- Group slotted option text under its row and report a menu close as an observation (SKY-19979) (#9306) (419927783)
- Fit the Add Credential dialog on phone-width screens (SKY-20111) (#9305) (3ae1f0d57)
- Replace CopyText with the shared CopyButton (SKY-20087) (#9304) (3da18e46d)
- Share the Copy API command menu items and report copy failures (SKY-20086) (#9303) (789d0b34d)
- Require admin for adapter configuration access regardless of RBAC (SKY-18299) (#9302) (d761a5e51)
- Reconnect a Google or Microsoft connection in place and keep its grants and account (SKY-19560) (#9301) (f94e606b8)
- Explain the Power BI by-design refusal and give refused runs a real failure category (SKY-20045) (#9300) (63b0c1362)
- Keep the browser and test runs on a Copilot turn where a secret was redacted (SKY-19956) (#9299) (aa5bf16de)
- Stop withholding Copilot screenshots for size after a credentialed run (SKY-19967) (#9298) (ba2f82958)
- Offer Attach a file and Demonstrate task from the Copilot plus button (SKY-19983) (#9297) (23ff61fdc)
- fix(SKY-20069): offer a list field of an earlier step in a loop's list slot (#9296) (443a4be80)
- Let orgs sign in to Bitwarden with a personal API key; stop at once on code prompts (SKY-20048) (#9295) (ea2d40c81)
- Rename the code block fallback's "Self-heal recovery" row to "Fallback to AI" (SKY-20071) (#9294) (0009e8909)
- Style the Copilot demonstration offer like the other Copilot cards (#9293) (8572a1a94)
- Offer "Allow on <site>" and drop Move on the credential site question (SKY-19941) (#9291) (9e485f0a7)
- Show agent step tool calls in order beside the step on the canvas, each with its settings (SKY-20019) (#9290) (6f30b9328)
- Doc: fix the review comments left open when two Doc PRs merged (#9289) (aec7009c7)
- Run the three FE/docs-reading tests on FE/docs-only PRs (SKY-19509) (#9288) (4a34a03a3)
- Bump version to 1.0.57 (#9282) (c531db3c1)
- Describe browser provisioning generically in two engine docstrings (SKY-20032) (#9287) (58fa8b749)
- Accept a Power BI result that exactly fills the saved row limit (SKY-20044) (#9286) (aab78a412)
- Give data-only Copilot code blocks a Goal that opens with their returned values (SKY-19371) (#9285) (96492c713)
- Group Agent settings into six folding groups with change summaries (#9284) (c4e014f41)
- Start the display recorder bridge without OTel auto-instrumentation (SKY-19682) (#9283) (3dd728e2c)
- Store Credentials-page secrets in AWS Secrets Manager on self-hosted AWS (#9281) (6c7d2ce0e)
- Stop telling every deployment that credentials need a Bitwarden server (#9280) (90152d044)
- Doc: shortcut hints in context, a grip beside each step, an insert line between steps (#9279) (e7e613573)
- Reword three test comments about downstream readers (SKY-20031) (#9278) (c5910f3ae)
- Copilot demonstration: keep a click that loads a new page (#9277) (b62114d16)
- fix(SKY-20024): list Demonstrate task after the matching steps in the Doc picker (#9276) (3961e835c)
- Start a task demonstration from the Doc's step menu (#9275) (3391b6de1)
- Doc: plain failure line, Enter runs the input box, truthful run results (#9274) (a0de4b5bb)
- Make typing in the Doc behave like Notion: quiet new steps, Enter on empty makes a note, / renames or replaces (#9273) (88740f483)
- Report start page and up
